faces.transcription:
This is a disrupt trial objective.
To set it up, separate the 11 Europe City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 4 of them faceup into the Operations area. These are the 4 trial cities.
Then, shuffle the remaining Europe cards back into the Player deck.
Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the 4 trial City cards.

JUNE OBJECTIVE 1
DISRUPT THE THIRD TRIAL
Disrupt Trial in:
1, 2, 3 OR 4 KNOWN CITIES IN EUROPE AT THE SAME TIME
Completed: Read Debrief 206
Failed: Read Debrief 190
